tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Qu'est-ce que le médecin t'a demandé ?”
B builds the answer as a reported question and chooses in the tile “si / ce que / ce qui / où”. si = yes/no question; où = place; ce que = what (object); ce qui = what (subject).
The word order stays that of a statement (il m'a demandé où j'ai mal): no est-ce que, no inversion. si + il / ils becomes s'il / s'ils; ce que + il / elle / on becomes ce qu'.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Check with the answer sheet at the end. Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.
